poc_plan:
POC for Dedicated (2 weeks):
- Week 1 canary: route 10% of production requests to Dedicated pool in us-east-1 (read-only search and embeddings). Model variant: rdx-2b-fp16 (baseline) vs rdx-2b-4bit-q (cost test). Metrics: p95 latency, token cost, error rate.
- Canary config: gradual ramp 0%->10% over 6 hours, health checks every 1 minute, auto-rollback triggers if error rate > 2% for 5m or p95 > 600ms for 10m.
- Week 2 stress & failover: simulate region outage (us-east fallback to hosted-api in us-west) to validate routing policies and rollout rollback scripts. Confirm KV cache warming time and cold-start latency.
- Success signals: stable p95 <300ms, cost per 1k tokens within 20% of projected, fallback time <30s, no data residency violations
routing_strategy: Canary -> canary percentage 10%; model variants for performance/cost tradeoffs; routing policies: prefer Dedicated in region, fallback to Hosted API in adjacent region with throttled burst policy; automatic rollback hooks via canary monitor
slo_targets: chat p95 < 300ms; embeddings batch latency p95 < 800ms; error rate < 1% overall; region failover recovery < 30s
security_notes: Requested: SAML SSO, SCIM mapping, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration (customer-managed), VPC peering and IP allowlist. Legal flagged data residency clause — must keep PII in us-east region for EU customers. Need access to audit logs (90 days) and retention controls.
commercial_notes: Interested in blended commit: 50% reserved Dedicated for predictable throughput + consumption for bursts. Wants a pricing example for 12-month term with 1 GPU pool and autoscale to 3 GPUs. Ask finance for ARR estimate and discount band.
